Package neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine

Class PlatformPowerSystemUnit

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.powergeneration.gasturbine.PlatformPowerSystemUnit
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, AutomationAddressable, ProcessEquipmentInterface, ProcessElementInterface, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface, LegacyLoadRepairable
public class PlatformPowerSystemUnit extends ProcessEquipmentBaseClass implements AutomationAddressable
Process unit that puts a PlatformPowerSystem into a flowsheet, on an electrical EnergyBus, and into ProcessAutomation. It is the adapter that lets CoupledProcessEnergySolver iterate a running process model together with the site-rated gas-turbine generators, shore power and bottoming cycle.

The unit offers the capacity of the power system at the ambient temperature to the bus as a balancing generator (EnergyPortMode.BALANCE): the bus then asks for the generation that the consumers on the bus request, up to the capacity, and reports unmet demand as a shortage. After the bus is solved the unit evaluates the power system at the allocated generation (PlatformPowerSystem.evaluate(double, double, double)) to give fuel, CO2, N-1 margin and the heat balance. Without a bus the unit uses a specified demand (setElectricDemand(double, String)). 


 EnergyBus bus = new EnergyBus("Platform A 66 kV", EnergyType.ELECTRICAL);
 PlatformPowerSystemUnit power = new PlatformPowerSystemUnit("Platform A power", platformPower);
 power.connectToBus(bus);
 // consumers (motors, drive trains) and an EnergyNetworkSolver on the same bus are added to the ProcessSystem
 power.setAmbientTemperature(25.0, "C");
 new CoupledProcessEnergySolver(process).solve();
 PlatformPowerSystem.Result r = power.getLastResult();

Automation addresses

Power-system automation addresses
Address (after the unit name) Type Unit
ambientTemperature, electricDemand, heatDemand input C, MW, MW (the electric demand is used only when the unit is not on a bus)
availablePower (capacity at the ambient temperature, no run needed), demand, deficit, n1Margin, shorePower, gasTurbinePower, fuel, co2, whruDuty, heatShortfall, utilisation, capacityLimited output MW, kg/hr for fuel and co2, fraction or flag otherwise
generator.NAME.availablePower, generator.NAME.loadFraction output MW, fraction
